dedupe_keys.name: 国土数値情報 道の駅 roads bridges and tunnels series on g spatial information center

description: 国土数値情報(道の駅 [roads, bridges and tunnels] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 不動産・建設経済局. 道路利用者のための「休憩機能」、道路利用者や地域住民のための「情報発信機能」、町と町が手を結び活力ある地域づくりを共に行うための「地域の連携機能」の3つの機能を併せ持つ休憩施設として設置されている「道の駅」位置を整備したものである。 作成年度：平成30年度 原典資料：国土政策局「道の駅位置の座標データ」 国土交通省「道の駅案内」「全国道の... Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 47 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 不動産・建設経済局. Its tags are デジタルシティ, 国交DPF, 国土数値情報, 岩手県. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
